reason: I've kept my grove in a notebook and in my head for forty years, and my sons or the agronomist at the ΚΥΔ handle the ΟΣΔΕ papers. I'm not paying €49 a year for a phone app to tell me what the guys at the καφενείο already tell me about the δάκος.
objection: Nothing here says it is certified or accepted for the eco-scheme (31.6) or by the ΚΥΔ. If the PDF diary isn't officially recognised, it's useless to me, and I don't trust a single developer's app to keep my records.
would_change_my_mind: If my ΚΥΔ agronomist told me this diary is officially accepted for the eco-scheme payment and set it up for me himself.
